parsed.lead:
The Mobile Command in your Base is where you can send Bots on Away Missions to earn additional resources.

You can select a Mission and choose which bots to deploy. Base rewards are guaranteed; succeeding in a mission give you bonus rewards. The higher leveled and ranked your Bots, the greater the probability of success. (Impossible, Low, Medium, High, Very High, Guaranteed) Missions sometimes have a recommended Class or two which further increases success rate if Bots of those classes are selected. The higher the Rarity of a Mission, the more Bots you can send for higher rewards.

More notes:

* Take into consideration that they will become unavailable to use in fights during the Mission.
* Each Mission costs Gold to start.
* Once you dispatch your Bots, you will have to wait until the countdown reaches zero to claim the rewards. Make sure that you claim the rewards within 3 days of Mission Completion or they will be lost. 
* Only one Mission can be run at a time. 
* Away missions can be canceled. However, you will not receive the rewards for the mission, and the Gold used to start the mission will be lost.
* You are prompted prior to beginning one of these missions to help avoid mistaken entries and prevent Gold loss. The warning can be turned off permanently from that prompt for any future away missions.
* Four Missions are presented at a time, which you have 2 hours to complete until they are updated with a new selection.
* You can re-roll the mission selection for 10 Energon if you don't like the rewards you see. No mission types are guaranteed and each re-roll will utilize the same mechanics that provide you with missions normally.

Rewards you could initally earn in Away Missions are Gold, Arena Chips, Raid Chips, Ore-13, and from Rare and Epic Missions, Tier 1 Spark Essence and Premium Bot Crystal Shards. There were also Missions for Tier 1 Mission Crystal Shards, but have since been removed.

sections.heading: July 26, 2019 update
sections.text:
New, improved away mission rewards! This update does away with the Arena Crystal rewards, but in exchange gives Commanders something bigger... the new T1, T2 and T3 Ore-13 Crystals, containing materials to upgrade your high-ranking Bots! As well as that, the cost to run Away Missions and their duration have been reduced significantly, so no more 2,000+ Gold and 5 hour Away Missions!

Then a few hours later they decided to rework the TX Crystals slightly - it was causing wayyyyy too much imbalance. Post-rework, T2 Crystals drop a boatload of Ore-13 and Gold, with zero chances of rare Sparks at the moment. This Away Mission update has just released. It may take some time to compile the list of missions. Note that as the tier of the Crystals given in Uncommon Missions may change depending on Commander Level, these Crystals will be referred to as TX Ore-13 Crystals.

Teletraan has uploaded optimized routes allowing us to send teams on Away Missions at the cost of less Gold, and for easier access to Gold and ORE-13, with a rare chance at Bot Chips and Bot Crystal Shards! Before we get into what you’ll be seeing, let’s talk about why we’re making these changes. We’re working towards creating more clearly defined reward identities for different Game Modes. We intend for Away Missions to be a place for Commanders to steadily earn Gold and ORE-13, and want it to be more accessible to more of our Commanders. We’re doing this by reducing the length of time these Away Missions take, and the cost of running them, but also by putting a bigger portion of the total rewards in the Base Rewards, with a slightly reduced focus on the Success Rewards. Keep your eyes on the Away Mission list Commanders, because you’ll quickly find the new Ore Crystals as a reward! Ore-13 Crystals scale from Tier 1 to Tier 3 based on your progression as a Commander, and contain rewards such as Ore and Gold, with rare chances at Basic, Class and Alpha Sparks. The higher the Tier, the rarer the Sparks. Tier 3 Ore Crystals even contain very rare chances at 1000x T4 Basic, Class, and T3 Alpha Spark Essence! You’ll see these Away Missions live in game around 10am PT July 25 , Commanders, but may need to wait until your Away Missions refresh.

as_of_2023.raw_wikitext: [[File:Alliance Mission menu v2.jpg|thumb|300x300px]] The '''[[Alliance]] Missions''' are a game mode in which the members of an Alliance cooperate together to complete Alliance maps to earn rewards. == How to Play == Alliance Mission start.png|The Leader or an Officer selects a Map and Difficulty, then starts the mission. Alliance Mission battlegroup.png|The Alliance is split into multiple Battlegroups for the Mission. Alliance Mission mission.png|Battle enemies to earn event points for the Alliance. Defeat certain Bots to remove linked effects from other enemies! Alliance Mission rewards.png|Earn as many points as possible! Compete against other Alliances for rank rewards at the end of the event. === The basics === In Alliance Missions, you and your Alliance will split into Battlegroups to simultaneously take on a challenging map together! Alliance Missions will push you to communicate, organize, and attack as a team to make your way through a Map full of new challenges. The Alliance leader or an officer can select the Map and Difficulty for the Mission. There are currently three maps to choose from; The Fallen Empire, the Orbital Command, and the Fractured Tomb. Each of these maps offers a level of Challenge, and differing rewards. The Difficulty level for each map is also configurable, which allows the alliance to select the perfect difficulty for their members. Move the slider back and forth to view the recommended team rating for the difficulty level of the selected Map, as well as preview the rewards available if it is completed. As you move the slider back and forth between difficulties, you’ll see the colour of the difficulty change to represent how well your Alliance is suited for that difficulty level. Prior to Version 4.1, increasing the difficulty of the map increases the required resource cost to run the map. This is where your Alliance Treasury comes in. Donate Gold and Loyalty to your treasury that you can use to open an Alliance Mission. Choosing how much to donate and what difficulty level is right for your alliance is up to you! However, there were several periods when Alliance Missions were free before '''''Version 4.1 removed Gold costs altogether.''''' Next, you’ll be separated into Battlegroups. If your Alliance has a full roster of 18, you’ll be able to split into 3 full Battlegroups of 6 Commanders. Each Battlegroup will take on the same map, but separately. Your objective is to take down the Boss at the very end while exploring as much of the Map as possible. Battlegroup 1.jpg|Battlegroup 1 Battlegroup 2.jpg|Battlegroup 2 Battlegroup 3.jpg|Battlegroup 3 === Once started === [[File:Alliance-Energy.png|thumb|51x51px]] An Alliance Mission, once started, lasts for 24 hours. The three Bots you take into the mission will not be available to use in other modes until the mission expires or when you reach the end of the map. Progressing through an Alliance mission map takes Alliance Mission Energy, which you have a maximum of five and recharges one hour 45 minutes (after 8.4) each. Alliance Mission Energy Refills are available to purchase when an Alliance Mission is active. You have three minutes 5 minutes 1 hour (as to discourage exploiting a timeout loophole with [[Waspinator]]'s signature) to defeat a Bot, or else there will a match timeout and your Bot will receive a half health penalty. Note that Bots on the map have their Signature Abilities at maximum level. (though some levels of some Bots have been reduced) === Linked Nodes and Mods === [[File:Linked_Nodes.jpg|thumb|left|256x256px]] Along the way, you’ll run into '''Linked Nodes''' and Mods. Linked Nodes are Mods that supply a boost to a different node somewhere on the map. Once the Bot on the node supplying the boost is taken down, the Bot receiving the boost will no longer get the benefits of the mod. This means that communication will be key as you and you Alliance decide how you will divide and conquer. In order to make the Map as manageable as possible, you will need to take down nodes for your Alliance-mates, and you’ll need to rely on them to do the same for you. Be prepared! Although there are some Bots you might be able to beat with the node on them still active, there are some bosses that will be VERY difficult unless they are removed! You’ve been warned! === Reaping the rewards === Just exploring as much of the map as possible will earn you Gold and Loyalty, but beating the final Boss will earn you and your Alliance even more Gold and Loyalty rewards, determined by the difficulty of the map selected, and earn shards that form crystals with a variety of desirable prizes by exploring every path! The harder the difficulty you choose, the more Shards and other rewards you can win! What else can you get from Alliance Missions? You can earn Milestone and Ranked Rewards! The points earned are determined by your Difficulty. You can earn some rewards just by hitting the Milestones, but the greatest rewards are saved for the Alliances that Rank the highest! Note there is a small level of randomness to it, since [[Sharkticon]]s are randomly selected and can award slightly higher or lower points than others. === How frequent are they? === Alliance Missions run on a series cadence. This means that they will be available for a set of days, followed by an off period for a few days. This means that Alliance Missions will be available for four days, and then take three days off. == Changes == *Alliance Missions first started at Friday, April 14th, 2017 at 5pm PDT. The first round was available for a three-day period. *Starting October 5, one day was removed from the schedule, making it a 4 days on, 3 days off schedule, meaning that they’ll start and end on the same day every week. Milestone Point thresholds by were reduced by 20% to match the reduction in days. *October 5th~8th had a zero cost Alliance Mission period. *By November 30, version 4.1, Gold costs were removed, and the Ancient Sanctum map was introduced. *v6.1 changed Milestone and Rank rewards, notably grouping top Alliance Rank rewards together, and updated Shattered Lands and Ancient Sanctum Crystal shards. *May 10~14, 2018 had double map completion and exploration rewards, and Alliance Mission Energy refresh was adjusted to 30 minutes. *April 4, 2019: Alliance Mission maps were completely updated: Fallen Empire, Orbital Command, and Fractured Tomb. ==History== ===Sonic Onslaught [[File:Sonic Onslaught mail.jpg|242x242px]]=== [[File:Sonic Onslaught.jpg|thumb]] '''June 2017''' - Soundwave ===Decepticon Supreme=== [[File:Decepticon Supreme.jpg|none|thumb|360x360px]] '''July 2017''' - ROTF Megatron ===Logical Authority=== August 2017 - Shockwave [[File:Logcial Authority rewards.webp|thumb]]''After 4-Million years on Cybertron, Shockwave has come to New Quintessa, and he’s taking Megatron’s post as the Boss of Alliance Missions! parsed.lead: The Alliance Missions are a game mode in which the members of an Alliance cooperate together to complete Alliance maps to earn rewards.

sections.heading: How to Play
sections.text:
Alliance Mission start.png|The Leader or an Officer selects a Map and Difficulty, then starts the mission.
Alliance Mission battlegroup.png|The Alliance is split into multiple Battlegroups for the Mission.
Alliance Mission mission.png|Battle enemies to earn event points for the Alliance. Defeat certain Bots to remove linked effects from other enemies!
Alliance Mission rewards.png|Earn as many points as possible! Compete against other Alliances for rank rewards at the end of the event.

sections.heading: The basics
sections.text:
In Alliance Missions, you and your Alliance will split into Battlegroups to simultaneously take on a challenging map together! Alliance Missions will push you to communicate, organize, and attack as a team to make your way through a Map full of new challenges.

The Alliance leader or an officer can select the Map and Difficulty for the Mission. There are currently three maps to choose from; The Fallen Empire, the Orbital Command, and the Fractured Tomb. Each of these maps offers a level of Challenge, and differing rewards.

The Difficulty level for each map is also configurable, which allows the alliance to select the perfect difficulty for their members. Move the slider back and forth to view the recommended team rating for the difficulty level of the selected Map, as well as preview the rewards available if it is completed. As you move the slider back and forth between difficulties, you’ll see the colour of the difficulty change to represent how well your Alliance is suited for that difficulty level.

Prior to Version 4.1, increasing the difficulty of the map increases the required resource cost to run the map. This is where your Alliance Treasury comes in. Donate Gold and Loyalty to your treasury that you can use to open an Alliance Mission. Choosing how much to donate and what difficulty level is right for your alliance is up to you! However, there were several periods when Alliance Missions were free before Version 4.1 removed Gold costs altogether.

Next, you’ll be separated into Battlegroups. If your Alliance has a full roster of 18, you’ll be able to split into 3 full Battlegroups of 6 Commanders. Each Battlegroup will take on the same map, but separately. Your objective is to take down the Boss at the very end while exploring as much of the Map as possible.

Battlegroup 2.jpg|Battlegroup 2
Battlegroup 3.jpg|Battlegroup 3

sections.heading: Once started
sections.text:
An Alliance Mission, once started, lasts for 24 hours. The three Bots you take into the mission will not be available to use in other modes until the mission expires or when you reach the end of the map. Progressing through an Alliance mission map takes Alliance Mission Energy, which you have a maximum of five and recharges one hour 45 minutes (after 8.4) each. Alliance Mission Energy Refills are available to purchase when an Alliance Mission is active. You have three minutes 5 minutes 1 hour (as to discourage exploiting a timeout loophole with Waspinator's signature) to defeat a Bot, or else there will a match timeout and your Bot will receive a half health penalty.

Note that Bots on the map have their Signature Abilities at maximum level. (though some levels of some Bots have been reduced)

sections.heading: Linked Nodes and Mods
sections.text: Along the way, you’ll run into Linked Nodes and Mods. Linked Nodes are Mods that supply a boost to a different node somewhere on the map. Once the Bot on the node supplying the boost is taken down, the Bot receiving the boost will no longer get the benefits of the mod. This means that communication will be key as you and you Alliance decide how you will divide and conquer. In order to make the Map as manageable as possible, you will need to take down nodes for your Alliance-mates, and you’ll need to rely on them to do the same for you. Be prepared! Although there are some Bots you might be able to beat with the node on them still active, there are some bosses that will be VERY difficult unless they are removed! You’ve been warned!

sections.heading: Reaping the rewards
sections.text:
Just exploring as much of the map as possible will earn you Gold and Loyalty, but beating the final Boss will earn you and your Alliance even more Gold and Loyalty rewards, determined by the difficulty of the map selected, and earn shards that form crystals with a variety of desirable prizes by exploring every path! The harder the difficulty you choose, the more Shards and other rewards you can win!

What else can you get from Alliance Missions? You can earn Milestone and Ranked Rewards! The points earned are determined by your Difficulty. You can earn some rewards just by hitting the Milestones, but the greatest rewards are saved for the Alliances that Rank the highest! Note there is a small level of randomness to it, since Sharkticons are randomly selected and can award slightly higher or lower points than others.

sections.heading: How frequent are they?
sections.text: Alliance Missions run on a series cadence. This means that they will be available for a set of days, followed by an off period for a few days. This means that Alliance Missions will be available for four days, and then take three days off.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.text:
*Alliance Missions first started at Friday, April 14th, 2017 at 5pm PDT. The first round was available for a three-day period.
*Starting October 5, one day was removed from the schedule, making it a 4 days on, 3 days off schedule, meaning that they’ll start and end on the same day every week. Milestone Point thresholds by were reduced by 20% to match the reduction in days.
*October 5th~8th had a zero cost Alliance Mission period.
*By November 30, version 4.1, Gold costs were removed, and the Ancient Sanctum map was introduced.
*v6.1 changed Milestone and Rank rewards, notably grouping top Alliance Rank rewards together, and updated Shattered Lands and Ancient Sanctum Crystal shards.
*May 10~14, 2018 had double map completion and exploration rewards, and Alliance Mission Energy refresh was adjusted to 30 minutes.
*April 4, 2019: Alliance Mission maps were completely updated: Fallen Empire, Orbital Command, and Fractured Tomb.

sections.heading: Logical Authority
sections.text:
August 2017 - Shockwave
After 4-Million years on Cybertron, Shockwave has come to New Quintessa, and he’s taking Megatron’s post as the Boss of Alliance Missions! The time has come once again, it’s time to refresh Alliance Missions!
* Map and Node Changes:
* Forgotten Ruins:
** This time, we’ll be making some small changes to the Forgotten Ruins Map. In addition to Shockwave dethroning Megatron, Ramjet is taking the place of Soundwave as the Miniboss.
** Bludgeon will be replaced by Drift, and Arcee is bowing out to Hot Rod. There are also a couple of other encounter changes, but you’ll discover those soon!
* Shattered Lands:
** Soundwave with a Special 1 Stun Buff remains the final Miniboss, but Drift will be replaced by Ramjet with a buff that extends Debuff durations, and Hot Rod will give up his spot to Starscream, who will be powered up by a Buff that intermittently increased the damage of his Ranged Attacks.
** Shockwave’s cold logic has determined that he will be replacing the 3 Bots that surround him as the Boss. Drift with a Ranged Attack Buff, Waspinator with a Power Flow Buff, and Ultra Magnus with an increased Special 1 Attack Buff will be protecting the new Boss!
** Standard encounters around the Map have also been refreshed, and feature some of our newer additions to the game.
* Rewards:
** We’ve also made some significant changes that should act to help even the playing field a bit for all of our Commanders, and assist in ranking up your Bots.
** The short of it is that you can expect more Alliances will have access to the rewards that they need to Rank Up their Bots. We’ve also done some shuffling, and have shifted some rewards from Milestones over to rewards that you receive for Map Completion!
** Before we start to break this down, we do need to address something that might prove unpopular among some of our Players. We have significantly reduced the amount of Tier 2 Alpha essence that can be earned through Alliance Missions at this time. The amount that was previously available was not the amount that was intended to be available, and though we considered leaving it where it was, this was giving the Alliances at the top end of the spectrum a means to move significantly further along than other Alliances, widening the gap between the Top End of Alliances, and Alliances that were just below them. This was also breaking the resource management and distribution of our system, where the Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence was far less rare than it should be, even in comparison to Tier 3 Basic Spark Essence.
** We know that this might be disappointing to some players, but hope that you guys can understand that this was a necessary change. Now, let’s get into this!
* Milestone Rewards:
** Point requirements haven’t changed for Milestones, but the rewards have. Like we said earlier, Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence has been largely decreased, since they were significantly higher than they should have been. The amount is quite a bit, with the Top Milestone dropping from 4000 Essence, to 200.
** Tier 1 Alpha and Tier 3 Basic Essence has been reduced as well, but have been added to Map Completion Rewards instead.
** While the Milestone Rewards before did achieve the effect of awarding Alliances based on the Difficulty they were participating in, it was done on the assumption that Alliances were all running 3 Battlegroups. Now, you will be rewarded for the difficulty you are attempting, even if you only have 1 Battlegroup able to 100% Explore the map.
** Map Completion Rewards:
** We wanted to make sure that players are able to earn Spark Essence appropriate to the difficulties that they are participating in. You’ll now be getting 2 different items for Map Completion, in addition to the Crystal Shards and Gold you were already receiving.
** Difficulties 1-15: Tier 2 Basic Spark Essence and Tier 1 Class Crystal Shards.
** Difficulties 16-40: Tier 1 Alpha, and Tier 2 Basic Spark Essence.
** Difficulties 41-65: Tier 3 Basic Spark and Tier 1 Alpha Spark Essence.
** Difficulties 66-100: Tier 2 Alpha Spark and Tier 3 Basic Spark Essence.
*** The higher the difficulty, the more Spark Essence you’ll win! For example, Difficulty 16 awards 50 Tier 1 Alpha Essence and 160 Tier 2 Basic Spark Essence, while Difficulty 25 will award 140 Tier 1 Alpha Essence and 297 Tier 2 Basic Spark Essence. You earn these Rewards for each Battlegroup that 100% Completes their Map, so you can earn 3 times the amount for 100% Exploration with all 3 Battlegroups! Take a look below for the complete list of Rewards per difficulty.
* Rank Rewards:
** We’ve added Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence to the Top 3 Rank Rewards, and increased the Tier 3 Basic Spark Essence for the Top 10 Alliances. We’ve also added more Tier 1 Alpha Spark Essence, more Tier 2 Basic Sparks, and more Tier 2 Class Sparks across the board.
** Prepare yourselves Commanders! The new iteration of Alliance Missions start tomorrow, August 16th! You’ll need to update to the newest version of the game to participate, so make sure to update when you see that 3.0 is available in the App Store or Google Play Store!

sections.heading: Power and Madness
sections.text:
October 2017

Shockwave proved a worthy adversary and boss in Alliance Missions, but the struggle for control of the Decepticons has brought a new challenger to the throne of Alliance Mission Boss. The deranged and power hungry Galvatron is here! Remember! Alliance Wars are now on a 4-Day on, 3 day off schedule! They will now start at 5am Pacific Time every Thursday morning!

* Map and Node Changes
* Forgotten Ruins:
** The Forgotten Ruins map is only seeing a small update, with Shockwave being replaced by Galvatron (with a Defensive Power Gain buff), and Megatron taking the place of Ramjet as the miniboss, with a Synergy node that will let him place extra Impair Charges.
* Shattered Lands:
** Similar to the Forgotten Ruins map, Ramjet will be replaced by Megatron, also with a Synergy buff that will grant him a chance to Stun opponents upon placing 20 impair charges. Starscream bows out as Soundwave and his Heavy Attack Stun buff move down to the 2nd Miniboss space. Taking Soundwave’s spot as the last Miniboss will be Shockwave, with his Synergy buff granting him the ability to passively generate Energy Charges.
* Milestone Changes
** Since we are now moving away from the 5-Day schedule of Alliance Missions, we’re reducing the points needed to achieve Milestones in Alliance Missions. The rewards haven’t changed this time, but remember that you’ll also be able to score Featured Bot chips from Milestone Rewards on weeks 2 and 4 of the month!

Galvatron's crazed lust for power is coming to an end, it is time for a true warrior to take his place, and fulfill the role of Alliance Mission boss, with honor and dignity. Dinobot is coming, and he's bringing along some of his ancient friends! This refresh of Alliance Missions is a small one, with only a few encounter changes.

* Forgotten Ruins
** Galvatron is gone, and Dinobot is in!

sections.heading: Absolute Power
sections.text:
Megatron was the final boss from December 2017 to May 2018.

The one true ruler of the Decepticons (or so he believes) is here! He’s gathering his most loyal warriors, and has unseated Dinobot as the boss of Alliance Missions! Can you and your Alliance take him on, or will he rip out your optics? This refresh of Alliance Missions will be the first to feature the brand new Ancient Sanctum map, and will have few refreshes of encounters for Forgotten Ruins and Shattered Lands.

* Forgotten Ruins
** Dinobot’s time has come to an end, it’s time for Megatron to take his place!

** Note: After our latest playtest, we realized that Soundwave with 2 Power Gain Mods was making him more difficult than we would like. We have replaced his Hemophobia 3 mod with Special Damage 3.

We’re adding 2 more Milestone Rewards in addition to what already exist!

* 4,500,000 - 300 Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence
* 7,000,000 - 500 Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence
* Now, the Map Rewards! The Forgotten Realm and Shattered Lands Map Rewards haven’t changed, but here’s a new updated chart with the new limit for Difficulty 65 for the Shattered Lands Map:

* You’ll notice that there are only 80 difficulty levels instead of 100. We’re still tuning those future difficulties, and may release them in the future.
* Lastly, introducing the new Ancient Sanctum crystal! Here’s what you can win from this brand new Crystal:
** 1x Tier 2 Alliance Mission Revive
** 1x Tier 2 Alliance Mission Team Revive
** 1x Tier 1 Alpha Spark
** 500x Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence
** 2500x Tier 3 Basic Spark Essence
** 250x Tier 3 Class Spark Essence (Random Class)
** Now, here are some of the more rare rewards that you can win from the Crystal:
** 1x Tier 3 Basic
** 1000x Tier 2 Alpha Spark Essence
** And if you’re REALLY lucky, you can win an entire Tier 2 Alpha Spark!
* Remember! Alliance Missions don’t cost any Gold to run anymore, and all fights are now on a 5 minute timer!

sections.heading: Recommendations
sections.text:
Alliance Leaders:

Push yourself to do higher difficulty Alliance Missions. The rewards are worth it, in order to help you progress further with the rank-up materials you need to advance further. This is especially important once you start having rank 3 4* bots. You'll keep getting Repair and Revive Kits via crystals and Raid Store rotating offers. They will go to waste if you remain comfortable at the current AM difficulty (be it Shattered Lands or Sanctum map). 

Once your 18 members are ready, push up for higher difficulty. There might still be a few that aren't strong enough hence that is when you replace them with stronger members. An alliance family helps a lot as you can swap weak/strong members down/up of the alliances so that replacing members isn't as much as a chore.
